{{Top|leg}}
'''Maintenance pods''' were small [[Starship/Legends|starships]] employed as repair vehicles. Three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long, the pods possessed a 150 meter long tether cord that anchored them to a hangar bay. Maintenance pods held three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] worth of air and maneuvered by employing small [[rocket engine]]s. The pods were equipped with a small [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], [[magnetic projector]]s, and two small [[Manipulator arm/Legends|manipulator arms]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' carried two maintenance pods.
